headline_angle.description: The strongest interpretive angle of the report. Should feel sharp, insight-led, and grounded in the source report.

key_message.description: The single most important message the reader should retain from the report.

summary.description: A professional 2-4 sentence summary covering what happened, why it matters, and the emphasized implication.

summary_sns_short.description: A short, high-density, perspective-driven social summary line.

summary_sns_post.description: A 3-6 sentence SNS-ready post that reframes the report with a clear perspective while remaining factually grounded.

hooks.description: Three to five distinct, curiosity-triggering hooks based on hidden shifts, structural implications, or overlooked angles in the report.

one_line_takeaway.description: A single-line directional takeaway telling the reader what to focus on, rethink, or prioritize.
